# Weekly Meal Rotation

## Fast dinners

- lentil pasta with spinach
- sheet-pan salmon with potatoes
- tofu stir-fry with frozen vegetables

## Batch cooking ideas

- chickpea curry for two lunches
- tomato soup that can be frozen in single portions
- taco filling that works in bowls or wraps

## Grocery reminders

- keep yogurt, fruit, and oats stocked for quick breakfasts
- freeze sliced bread so weekday mornings stay easy
